whyThisBoundaryIsValid: The retained native pose update can temporarily assign the native geometry/material to v.mesh. The procedural renderer wrapper chooses the draw index, groups and material slots when a real render occurs. The save setup intentionally suppresses render, so its native-input state can be checked immediately while its draw cache must be compared at the later actual-render boundary. This does not authorize changing any native geometry or repairing state to match a reference.
